content:
raina: Heads-up — FinServCo kickoff tomorrow. Need to confirm POC access matrix. They want: hosted API keys for 3 app engineers, ephemeral keys for CI, a small dedicated pool for throughput tests (~2x T4x2) for 2 weeks, and VPC/private later.

omar: For dedicated pool we can spin up a trial pool in our staging region. ETA 48–72h after contract is signed. Need customer CIDR + expected concurrency. Can we get the workload profile?

raina: I'll collect concurrency. Also SSO + SAML required. Is SSO provisioning manual or automated? @kevin

kevin: SSO is supported via SAML; we can federate to customer IdP. For POC we usually create temporary service accounts if SAML not ready. KMS: we provide customer-managed keys for Private but hosted requires our KMS (we can add attestations). Audit logs are available; IP allowlist + per-key scope supported. Send the security questionnaire sections and I'll flag blockers.

tess: RBAC recommendation for POC: create a workspace 'finserv-poc' with roles: workspace-admin (can invite & billing), engineer (token mint, deployments), viewer (read-only dashboards), se-account (limited to model routes). Use ephemeral API keys for CI: `POST /v1/keys` with limited scopes and TTL. Keep number of admins minimal.

lindsey: Pricing note: we can offer a 30-day dedicated trial at 50% list for sales-assisted POCs. Add-on: extended logs retention is extra. I'll send a quote. Also need to confirm that this counts as 'trial' for quota reasons.

raina: Customer asked about least-privilege invite flow — can we auto-provision guest roles for external consultants? They should not see billing.

omar: Yes — create invite with role=engineer or viewer. Backend has `role` enum. Example:
```
POST /workspaces/finserv-poc/invites
{
  "email": "contractor@vendor.com",
  "role": "engineer",
  "scopes": ["generate","embed"],
  "expires_at": "2024-08-15T00:00:00Z"
}
```
We enforce billing=false for non-admin roles.

kevin: Security note: For enterprise questionnaire, they'll ask about data residency/KMS/retention. Hosted POC keeps inference logs for 30 days by default; we can extend or disable. If they need on-prem, move to Private.

infra-bot: provisioning:dedicated-pool request queued (req-9732). ETA 60 hours.

raina: Great — I'll update the SOW with the SSO, dedicated trial, and RBAC spec. @lindsey please attach the quote; @kevin I'll DM the questionnaire.

lindsey: Quote uploaded to the drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/finserv/quote_poc_v1.pdf. I'll flag the contract team for fast-sign.

kevin: Received. I'll start the security checklist and call out anything blocking.

raina: Thanks team :thumbsup:
